title: Deploy Qwen2.5 Coder via Ollama HTTP pull and prove OpenClaw tool execution
script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$work='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench';New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $work|Out-Null;$model='qwen2.5-coder:14b-instruct-q4_K_S';$ep=Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint-v414.json';if(-not(Test-Path $ep)){throw 'OLLAMA_ENDPOINT_ARTIFACT_MISSING'};$base=(Get-Content $ep -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json).baseUrl;$tags=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'/api/tags') -TimeoutSec 15;$present=@($tags.models|ForEach-Object{$_.name}) -contains $model;if(-not $present){Write-Output ('V441_057J_PULL_START='+$model);$pullBody=@{model=$model;stream=$false}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5;$pull=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/pull') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $pullBody -TimeoutSec 3600;if($null -ne $pull.status){Write-Output ('V441_057J_PULL_STATUS='+$pull.status)};$tags=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'/api/tags') -TimeoutSec 15;$present=@($tags.models|ForEach-Object{$_.name}) -contains $model;if(-not $present){throw 'OLLAMA_PULL_DID_NOT_INSTALL_MODEL'}}else{Write-Output ('V441_057J_MODEL_PRESENT='+$model)};$showBody=@{model=$model}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5;$show=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/show') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $showBody -TimeoutSec 30;$caps=@($show.capabilities);Write-Output ('V441_057J_CAPS='+($caps -join ','));if($caps -notcontains 'tools'){throw 'MODEL_HAS_NO_TOOLS_CAPABILITY'};$tool=@{type='function';function=@{name='write_probe';description='Create a probe file';parameters=@{type='object';properties=@{path=@{type='string'};content=@{type='string'}};required=@('path','content')}}};$chatBody=@{model=$model;stream=$false;messages=@(@{role='user';content='Call write_probe with path C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/qwen-native-tool-probe.txt and content QWEN_NATIVE_TOOL_OK. Do not answer normally. Call the tool.'});tools=@($tool)}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20;$resp=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/chat') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $chatBody -TimeoutSec 300;$msg=$resp.message;$tc=@();if($null -ne $msg -and ($msg.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'tool_calls') -and $null -ne $msg.tool_calls){$tc=@($msg.tool_calls)};Write-Output ('V441_057J_NATIVE_TOOL_CALLS='+$tc.Count);if($tc.Count -lt 1){$txt='';if($null -ne $msg -and ($msg.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'content')){$txt=[string]$msg.content};Write-Output ('V441_057J_NATIVE_CONTENT='+($txt -replace '[
]+',' '));throw 'QWEN_NATIVE_TOOL_CALL_FAILED'};$fn=$tc[0].function;$args=$fn.arguments;if($args -is [string]){$args=$args|ConvertFrom-Json};if($fn.name -ne 'write_probe'){throw ('UNEXPECTED_NATIVE_TOOL='+$fn.name)};if([string]$args.path -ne 'C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/qwen-native-tool-probe.txt' -or [string]$args.content -ne 'QWEN_NATIVE_TOOL_OK'){throw 'NATIVE_TOOL_ARGUMENT_MISMATCH'};Write-Output 'V441_057J_NATIVE=PASS';$cfg=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw/openclaw.json';$c=Get-Content $cfg -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(-not $c.agents.defaults.models){$c.agents.defaults|Add-Member -NotePropertyName models -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{})};$key='ollama/'+$model;if(-not ($c.agents.defaults.models.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $key)){$c.agents.defaults.models|Add-Member -NotePropertyName $key -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{})};$oldPrimary=[string]$c.agents.defaults.model.primary;$c.agents.defaults.model.primary=$key;$c|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50|Set-Content $cfg -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output ('V441_057J_PRIMARY_OLD='+$oldPrimary);Write-Output ('V441_057J_PRIMARY_NEW='+$key);& openclaw.cmd gateway restart 2>&1|Out-Null;Start-Sleep -Seconds 4;$target=Join-Path $work 'openclaw-qwen-tool-proof.txt';Remove-Item $target -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$prompt='Use the write tool to create exactly C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/openclaw-qwen-tool-proof.txt with exactly this single line: OPENCLAW_QWEN_TOOL_OK . You must actually invoke the write tool. After success reply exactly OPENCLAW_QWEN_TOOL_DONE';$raw=& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key '3en-057j-qwen' --message $prompt --json --timeout 180 2>&1;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;Write-Output ('V441_057J_AGENT_EXIT='+$code);if($code -ne 0){throw 'OPENCLAW_QWEN_AGENT_FAILED'};if(-not(Test-Path $target)){throw 'OPENCLAW_QWEN_FILE_NOT_CREATED'};$content=(Get-Content $target -Raw).Trim();if($content -ne 'OPENCLAW_QWEN_TOOL_OK'){throw ('OPENCLAW_QWEN_CONTENT_MISMATCH='+$content)};Write-Output 'V441_057J_OPENCLAW_TOOL=PASS';$model|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'selected-tool-model.txt') -Encoding ASCII;Write-Output ('V441_057J_WINNER='+$model)
